properties.reason: Back-left greenside bunker of 17 is one continuous sand area (E 238-253, N 4810987-995; bright sand in RGB, one hollow in the LiDAR) but the model splits it into two pieces and leaves the middle (E 244.5-250) as rough.

Fill the 9 m gap right of the 17 tees between the traced path coming down from the 18 tee (ends E 320 N 880) and the one continuing to the 16 green (starts E 325 N 873); continuous under tree shadow in RGB/NIR.

Mown approach right-front of the 17 green between the front and right bunkers (E 260-271, N 4810955-966): darker green turf in RGB, high NDVI, and mapped in OSM as a small fairway (way 918932881). The model has it as rough.

Clears the 836 m2 automatic tee polygon (E 284-318, N 4810849-895) that merges the 17 Gold and middle (Red/White) boxes and the bank between them. Being over 500 m2 it is exempt from tee levelling, so the Gold marker sits on the 2018 slope (23 % plane, 347.6-350.9 m under the 2025 Gold box) and the middle box keeps two 2018 levels (351.3 / 350.45 m). Burned as rough here; features 1 and 2 put the two 2025 boxes back on top. Only overwrites tee/17. (QA round 2)

2025 Gold box of 17 (E 284.6-307.6, N 4810873.4-893.1): a crisp mown rectangle in the 2025 photo, matching OSM tee 918932876 within ~0.5 m. It was built after the 2018 survey: the LiDAR under it is a 23 % slope (347.6-350.9 m), so as its own <500 m2 polygon it gets a synthetic deck. The pale strip SE of it (dead turf, the bank down from the middle box) stays rough. Overwrites tee/17 and 18 m2 of rough/99 at the box corners. (QA round 2)

2025 middle (Red/White) box of 17 (E 289-319.7, N 4810848.8-875.9): one uniform mown rectangle in the 2025 photo with no bank inside it, matching OSM tee 918932875 within ~0.5 m. The 2018 LiDAR still has two levels here (351.3 m SW, 350.45 m NE, a 0.8 m bank across the box), so the box was rebuilt after 2018; as its own 474 m2 polygon it is levelled. Must come after feature 1 (the later-levelled box wins the shared bank). Overwrites tee/17 and 14 m2 of rough/99. (QA round 2)
